 In Re: Cran 3 of 2025
1.

The affidavit of service filed by the petitioners is taken on record.
2.
Both the learned counsel appearing on behalf of the petitioners as  well as the respondent are present.
3. Learned counsel appearing on behalf of the petitioners has prayed for extension of interim order which was initially promulgated on 9th December, 2024.
4. Considering all the facts and circumstances, the interim order earlier promulgated by this Court be extended till 31st July, 2025 or until further order, whichever is earlier.
5. Accordingly, the application being CRAN 3 of 2025 stands disposed of.
6. Time to file affidavit-in-opposition at the instance of the respondent be extended and directed to file affidavit-in-opposition and reply, if any, be filed in the mean time.

7. Let the matter appear in the monthly list of July, 2025.
8.
All parties shall act on the server copy of this order duly downloaded from the official website of this Court.

(Bibhas Ranjan De, J.)
